question.text: For a Cat III AIF trust, if Section 161(1A) applies (business income in Determinate Trust):

answer.text: Business income taxed at MMR payable by the Trustee

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.2.1, Section 161(1A) mandates MMR on business income of Determinate Trust, payable by Trustee (representative assessee). **The Trap:** Exemption/pass-through don't apply to business income in Determinate Trust. **Cross-Exam Context:** Fundamental trust-taxation principle. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Keep Trustee's MMR filings on record to defend any AO queries.
